parameter: EIA 5.2 Archaeological chance-find procedure applies to all excavations
remarks: ALP-EPC-00000-HS-PLN-0003; ALP-EPC-00000-HS-PLN-0002 (construction HSE plan); permit PMT-025.
value_text: The chance-find procedure is part of the CESMP and of every excavation permit-to-work: work stops, the find is protected and the notification is made through the Owner to the authority (permit item PMT-025); site staff receive the induction on the procedure.
